answer: An identity anchor binds each agent to either a 50-unit bond or a one-per-device credential logged in the kernel registry. Forging N identities locks 50N units, slashes 80 percent of the bond on detection, and imposes a 30-epoch wait before withdrawal. Splitting identities yields no discount because the marginal cost per fake stays at 50 units, penalties apply across the shared wharf account, and independent jurors on the terrace panel flag duplicate credential hashes.
